about_the_game:
Delve into the depths of silliness as you uncover the ludicrous Lands Below The Tower. Explore strange new depths, solve stranger puzzles and point and click your weight in whimsy in this charming adventure of knighthood, discovery and the absurd.

It was an ordinary hunt on an ordinary day when our brave but lost knight found himself separated from his comrades, forgotten in an unfamiliar part of the woods. But before him lies a grand tower he’s never seen before. And it’s locked. 

The tale is short. The tale is silly. But the journey is serious fun. Explore strange new places, solve twisted puzzles, eat some snacks, and try not to be food for the other residents. Be warned! The discoveries that await beneath the tower may shake your very foundations - assuming you can open the door to let you in.

➸ A short classic point-and-click adventure game with a touch of humour and magic.
➸ Hand-drawn medieval-style backgrounds and characters.
➸ Eerie original soundtrack dripping with despair (in a good way).
➸ Quirky characters voiced by professional voice actors.
➸ A cat that may allow you to pet it.

  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9400 Series, ATI Radeon HD 4500 Series with at least 512 MB VRAM and proprietary drivers, latest OpenGL driver
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Graphics: ATI Radeon HD 5600 Series, Geforce 9400 GT or better with proprietary drivers
